title: Mooney-Rivlin hyperelastic model
objective: Add a Mooney-Rivlin constitutive model with strain energy Psi = C1(I1_bar - 3) + C2(I2_bar - 3) + (kappa/2)(J - 1)^2.
scope: Derive S, C from the two-invariant isochoric decomposition.
At C2 = 0 the model must reduce exactly to neo-Hookean with mu = 2 C1.
implementation_steps: Derive S_IJ from Psi using the chain rule through (I1_bar, I2_bar, J).
Unit-test F = I and the C2 = 0 neo-Hookean limit.
Unit-test simple shear against a closed-form rubber benchmark.
acceptance_criteria: At C2 = 0, Mooney-Rivlin == Neo-Hookean with mu = 2*C1 to 1e-12.
Simple shear matches the closed-form rubber benchmark to 1e-6.
risks: I2_bar differentiation is algebraically noisier than I1_bar. Mitigation: use SymPy for the derivation and simplify before code-generating.
completion_notes: Closed-form PK2 and 4th-order tangent derived by hand through (I1_bar, I2_bar, J) chain rule
C1-tangent block structurally identical to NH iso (mu -> 2*C1); C2=0 reduction exact to 1e-12
Hand-derived simple-shear closed form for S_00/S_11/S_22/S_01 (J=1, I1=I2=3+gamma^2)
Updated four pre-existing tests that used 'mooney_rivlin' as the 'not-yet-supported' sentinel to use 'ogden' instead
Gate A/B/C all passed first attempt; 9/9 task tests + 1127-test regression green
